pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Whispered Narration Intro]
(soft sogeum airy breath, distant gayageum harmonics and melancholic ajaeng drone, signature hook melody introduced in first 10 seconds)

기억하니, 그 밤의 별빛 아래
너의 미소가 내 세상을 밝혔지
떨리던 손끝에 스친 너의 온기 still remains

[Verse 1]
(low ajaeng sustained notes with delicate gayageum plucks, subtle janggu rhythm evoking memory)

시간이 흘러도 지워지지 않아
내 안에 너는 여전히 살아 있어
너는 나의 모든 순간이었어

[Pre-Chorus]
(gayageum arpeggio rising with emotion, ajaeng glissando, percussion layering slowly, taepyeongso soft longing tease)

눈물 속에 웃던 그날처럼
다시는 돌아갈 수 없단 걸 알아도

[BUILD]
(janggu & buk rolls increasing density, ajaeng pitch rising, deep sub bass rumble growing, sogeum ornamentation building tension)

[DROP]
(silence 0.6sec → immediate heavy punch: deep sub bass + janggu/buk powerful hit, taepyeongso lead dominates with emotional soaring melody, gayageum rhythm flowing through)

너는 나의 모든 순간이었어
눈물 속에 웃던 그날처럼
난 아직도 널 사랑해 tonight
remember you forever

[Chorus]
(full traditional fusion groove, bright female vocal with deep emotion, male deep low harmony anchoring sorrowfully)

너는 나의 모든 순간이었어
눈물 속에 웃던 그날처럼
다시는 돌아갈 수 없단 걸 알아도
난 아직도 널 사랑해

[Verse 2]
(softer ajaeng long tones, gayageum delicate strums, male low vocal adding heavy longing)

비가 내리면 네가 떠올라
우산 속에 숨긴 내 마음이 울어
그리움은 파도처럼 밀려와

[Rap Break]
(male deep aggressive rhythmic rap, driving janggu & buk with afrobeat groove, ajaeng low emotional stabs, taepyeongso short melancholic motifs)

Yo, memories hit like rain under the Joseon moon
Your smile still lights up my empty room
Ajaeng cries deep, gayageum strings bleed
Taepyeongso screams what my heart still needs
Even if I can't go back, the bass keeps me alive
Your name echoes forever, in this night I survive

[BUILD 2]
(denser percussion layers, rising taepyeongso wail with trills, full sub bass swell, maximum emotional tension)

[DROP 2]
(immediate heavy impact, taepyeongso lead stronger with soaring emotional melody, full percussion explosion, female bright emotional adlib)

너는 나의 모든 순간이었어
눈물 속에 웃던 그날처럼
난 아직도 널 사랑해 tonight
remember you forever

[Final Chorus]
(maximum energy, layered male & female vocals, full instrumentation with powerful hook repetition)

너는 나의 모든 순간이었어
눈물 속에 웃던 그날처럼
다시는 돌아갈 수 없단 걸 알아도
난 아직도 널 사랑해
너는 나의 모든 꿈이었어
아픈 사랑조차 아름다웠던 너
세상이 멈춰도 변치 않을 마음
너와의 애절한 사랑 이야기

[Outro]
(fade with sogeum soft air, lingering gayageum harmonics and melancholic ajaeng drone, whispered male "still love you... remember")
pkg.sunoStyle:

Instruments: gayageum, ajaeng, taepyeongso, sogeum, janggu, buk, kkwaenggwari, jing.
Bass: deep sub bass, strong, punchy, clean from kick.
Drums: afrobeat groove + Korean traditional rhythm.
Drop: instant hit after build, bass + Korean percussion dominate. Taepyeongso or ajaeng lead within 0.3 sec. Kkwaenggwari for tension only, jing for resonance.
Vocal: female bright and emotional. male deep, thick, heavy and resonant.
Male rap: aggressive, rhythmic, low-register English rap.
Structure: build → drop → chorus. 100-110 BPM.
Atmosphere: traditional + modern + cinematic Joseon night vibe.
Restrictions: no modern synth lead, no weak bass, no thin vocal, traditional instruments must remain clearly recognizable.
